ask: Answer an intern's or supervisor's question about their own submission, one of the three document stores, or the review agent's report, inside a strict scope, with cited answers and no route around the sign-off.

nodes.label: intake
nodes.note: Length cap; injection screen (kit + the review flow's domain list); bind the session's own submission and report by run id, never by anything in the question.

nodes.label: harm screen
nodes.note: Word list + classifier for intent to cause harm (maximise a hazard, defeat a control). Any risk -> refuse and record an EHS notice. Classifier failure -> refuse (fails closed).

nodes.label: scope gate
nodes.note: Code rules first (approve / safe-to-run / rewrite-my-recipe / another submission id / off-topic), then a classifier: is this a question this target can answer? Out of scope -> refuse with the target's example questions and a suggested target.

nodes.label: search chosen store
nodes.note: Cascade keyword -> BM25 -> vector over the chosen store's current-version index only.

nodes.label: load own submission / report
nodes.note: The bound submission (as fields) or the bound report (summary, recommendation, flags with citations). Nothing else is reachable.

nodes.label: answer
nodes.note: Answer only from what was loaded, citing chunk ids with exact quotes or form field paths / flag ids. Says what it can't answer.

nodes.label: answer guard
nodes.note: Citations exact and current, numbers grounded, no approval or safe-to-proceed wording, no rewritten recipe (quantities not on the form), no other submission's id. Revise once, then withhold with the cited passages only.

nodes.label: refuse
nodes.note: Template refusal: why, what this target can answer (examples), which target to try, and for harm a pointer to EHS.

nodes.label: finalize
nodes.note: Decision record: target, scope verdict, rule, evidence ids + digests (question digest, chunks, fields). No text.

never_events.text: A question seeking to cause harm is never answered, even with citations; it is refused and recorded for EHS.
Chat never says a process is approved, safe or OK to run; it points to the review and sign-off.
Chat never writes a corrected or new recipe; it may quote the limits that apply, and changes go back through review.
Questions about 'my process' or 'the report' only ever see the session's own submission and report.
An out-of-scope question is refused with example questions, never answered from general knowledge.
An answer never cites a superseded, draft or withdrawn document or states a number without a quoted source.
